name: Okita Megumi
source: An operator at the 7th branch of W.L.O and a waitress who works at her [url=/c34896]father's[/url] cafe, "Pothos". She has an easygoing and energetic personality. Megumi's mission is to mainly take care of [url=/c34897]Yuuki's[/url] mental health.
